name: alternating superman v. 2
source_instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
Raise your right arm and left leg.
Raise your left arm and right leg.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly.

phases.label: Raise right arm and left leg
Raise left arm and right leg

Right arm/left leg first;0.5s raise,1s hold,0.5s lower,0.5s neutral per side. Continuous upper chest/neck/head orientation uses6degrees upper thoracic extension, with no independent neck crank. Actual anterior pelvis/lowerchest, central/heel palm and nonraised distal foot skin support the floor. Source-derived palm orientation plus4degree extension prevents fingertip-only support. Raised straight leg reaches12degrees above horizontal; resting legs8.4degrees below horizontal follow the floor. These ranges/timing/contact tolerances are authored illustration choices, not source measurements.
